title: Covering design C(17,7,4,6)
statement: Find 7-subsets (blocks) of {1, ..., 17} such that every 6-subset meets some block in at least 4 points, with as few blocks as possible. The best known size in the Covering Repository is 17 blocks (ours); a design with fewer blocks improves it.
submission: Text file: one block per line, 7 distinct points from 1..17 separated by spaces.

best_known.source: Covering Repository (coveringrepository.com), C(17,7,4,6) = 17 blocks: ours, listed since 2026-10-26 (before it 18); read 6 Nov 2026
